findings.title: Consecration redirects access into bounded provision
findings.claim: The focus pairs release from prohibition with a sea domain and a consecrated land boundary: access is redistributed by setting, while the permitted sea resource remains usable for the addressed people and the traveling company.
findings.mechanism: The passive permission form at 5:96:1 meets the later prohibition and consecrated-state forms, while sea and land supply opposed domain carriers and the traveler noun gives permission a beneficiary direction. Their contact changes the rule from undifferentiated abstention into a bounded access arrangement.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see the legal contrast as an operating arrangement: a protected terrestrial field coexists with a permitted maritime provision that can sustain people on the road.
findings.containment: This preserves the ordinary sea-catch permission and land-catch restriction. The managed-access image does not generalize the allowance beyond the focus domains, and the wide reader's references to other ayat remain qualified rather than independently asserted here.

epistemic.reason: The citable published finding directly supplies the paired sea-land and consecration relation; the traveler-beneficiary extension is carried by a legacy wide reader record and is therefore explicitly qualified.

findings.title: Portable provision enters a common return
findings.claim: The focus's usable provision is addressed both to those present and to a traveling company, and the closing gathering turns that mobile benefit toward a common destination.
findings.mechanism: The material-benefit branch on mataa meets the independently named traveler group, while the passive gathering verb supplies the endpoint. The three focus carriers therefore form a provision-to-movement-to-gathering relation.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive the traveler clause as functional movement: provision accompanies dispersed travelers, and the ayah's final verb gathers the routes into one horizon.
findings.containment: This adds a movement toward common gathering to the ordinary benefit for travelers. It does not turn the food into a metaphor, erase the legal rule, or make every journey identical with the final assembly.

epistemic.reason: The citable source supplies the complete three-branch relation but grades the cross-run synthesis weak, so the changed reading remains qualified rather than presented as a lexical certainty.

findings.title: Duration times the operative status
findings.claim: The focus duration construction makes the land-catch restraint last while the consecrated state remains operative, and the attributed witness scene supplies a role-scoped parallel for that timing.
findings.mechanism: The exact 5:117 trace bounds witnessing by presence and marks a transition after the witness is taken, while the focus places the same continuance construction beside the consecrated-state predicate. Their contact changes the condition from a loose temporal aside into a timer attached to the status that generates the restraint.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can feel the legal boundary as active only for the duration of its generating state, with the later witness example making the force of that duration more precise.
findings.containment: The duration reading remains attributed contextual evidence and preserves the ordinary conditional prohibition. It does not equate ritual status with a person's presence or claim a general grammatical doctrine beyond the two supplied constructions.

epistemic.reason: The HFT provides exact coordinates and a medium-strength changed reading, but the witness and transition branch records are unresolved and the source identity is legacy_unbound.

findings.title: Ordinary provision meets accountable request
findings.claim: The focus presents sea food as ordinary usable provision answered by protective restraint, while the attributed table episode links a later food request to settled hearts, verified promise, and heightened accountability without ceasing to be provision.
findings.mechanism: The focus food and protective-command carriers meet exact HFT context roles for staged food, repeated protection, tranquility, verification, and bestowed provision. The contact changes the food phrase from a merely consumable category into one pole of an epistemic contrast between unforced sustenance and a request that seeks confirmation.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive why the focus ends in protective restraint: provision is usable and ordinary here, while a later request for provision also bears the burden of settling uncertainty and verifying a promise.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory, remote contrast between ordinary sea provision and the requested heavenly table. Both remain tied to eating, provision, and protective piety; the reading does not equate the foods, reject the table episode, or invent independent glosses for unresolved context branches.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace supplies exact context ayahs, word indices, attributed roles, and focus returns, but its confidence is exploratory and all context branch records except the focus branches are unresolved.
